entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The Skytree...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The view from above is fascinating.[n]The construction itself, equally so...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Its form is simultaneously traditional[n]and innovative. This tower is true art!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I heard that its subtle curves were[n]based on the curvature of a katana.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You can really feel the connection to[n]cultural traditions. I think that's wonderful.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah! You understand...!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well then, would you like to discuss the[n]beauty of curves with me further?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Yikes! Don't listen to this pervert!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Who are you calling a pervert!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I heard you guys went on an adventure[n]to the Skytree while I was recovering...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You're so mean, Sojiro. You could[n]have waited till I got better.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sorry about that. I didn't think you'd[n]care about this sorta thing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I know! Why don't we all go together next[n]time? We can tackle this quest as a party!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whoa! Now you're speakin' my language!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro! As atonement, you'll be the one to[n]take us there!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I have to go too!?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Yeah, yeah, okay.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I hear the real Skytree is over six[n]hundred meters tall.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It's as if it is reaching for the heavens.[n]You can see the whole city from up there.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I've been to the top before. It certainly[n]is something.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Maybe I'll be able to go again when I[n]finish my current assignment...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Huh!? That melancholy look in your[n]eyes...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I sense a bittersweet memory of love![n]Am I right? Tell me I'm right!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Wha—!? Calm down! I don't accept[n]interviews without an appointment!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: When I was young, I could never have[n]imagined that this country would be able[n]to build a tower of this magnitude.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I wonder what else will change by the[n]time the next generation grows up.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Isn't it your job to make sure it keeps[n]changing for the better, Mr. Politician?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Ah, yes... That's exactly right.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We came here in the afternoon last[n]time, but don't you guys think it'd be[n]way cooler at night?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Definitely. The view of the city lights[n]after sundown is unlike anything else.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: City lights... That does sound pretty good.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh! Maybe if I went there with Lady Ann[n]at night...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Mewhehehee...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Where the hell is his mind goin'?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's just... leave him be.
